subject: Request: 2 Platform/Runtime Hires + Offer Bands
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 2 Platform/Runtime Hires + Offer Bands

Team —

I'm requesting approval to open two headcount slots on the platform/runtime org for Q2 hiring: one Senior Runtime Engineer (IC5) and one Platform Reliability Engineer (SRE, IC4+). Brief rationale below: 

- Business need: recent Dedicated customers and a spike in long-tail latency issues require dedicated runtime ownership and reliability work. Delivery risk for existing onboarding backlog is increasing.
- Timeline: want to extend offers by end of May to hit June start dates.
- Request: 2 FTEs (1 IC5 runtime, 1 IC4/IC4+ SRE).

Comp bands proposed (market-checked with Talent):
- Senior Runtime (IC5): base band L5 — $200,000–$250,000
- Platform Reliability (IC4/IC4+): band L4/L4+ — $150,000–$190,000

Proposed offer authority (to avoid slow approvals for top candidates): hiring manager + head of platform can approve up to 5% above midpoint within band, and up to $10k signing bonus. Anything beyond goes to Rishi for sign-off. See attached HC request and offer template.

Cost: total OTE (first year comp+signing+onboarding) estimated at ~$520k for both roles — covered in Platform FY27 hiring plan (attached).

Action items: please reply with: approve / approve with adjustments / deny, and any guidance on max comp and equity bands. If approved, I'll ask Ben Lee to move candidates through final stage and prepare offers.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HC_Request_2027-05_grace.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2 Platform/Runtime Hires + Offer Bands

Grace —

Thanks for the clear ask and cost breakdown. I approve the headcount in principle. A few clarifying questions before I sign off on the authority thresholds: 

1) Are the bands inclusive of equity? Please confirm the target equity ranges for each role (grant size / cliff / refresh cadence).
2) Relocation + signing: confirm whether the $10k signing cap is per offer and whether relocation is expected for either candidate (if so, do we have a relocation budget line).
3) Cost center and headcount code: please confirm which cost center these will come from (Platform R&D vs. Infra ops). I want to flag this with finance.

If we keep offers within these limits, you have my approval to extend offers. If a candidate requires > 5% stretch or > $10k signing, loop me and include the recruiter note.

On bands: given market movements, I'm comfortable enabling an upper stretch to $260k for truly exceptional IC5 candidates (approval still required). For equity, propose: 
- IC5: 0.15%–0.30% initial RSU grant
- IC4/SRE: 0.05%–0.15% initial RSU grant

Please update the offer template with the equity ranges and send me the final before Ben moves to verbal.

-Rishi
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2 Platform/Runtime Hires + Offer Bands

Thanks — I support moving forward. A couple of practical notes from the hiring side: 

- Interview loop: propose final onsite loop that includes kernel/runtime tech screen, scale design, and a short troubleshooting exercise with a production incident we own. That will help differentiate SRE vs runtime candidates.
- Internal candidates: please check internal slate first; I'd rather promote/transfer if we have strong fits.
- Top-of-band flexibility: I agree up to $260k for a top IC5, but we should reserve that only for candidates with proven low-latency system experience. For comp approvals above $260k, let's follow Rishi's escalation path.
- Timeline: Ben Lee has 2 finalists for the IC5 (external) and an internal candidate for the SRE. If we can lock offer authority today, Ben can take the IC5 verbal this week.

Also — if the hiring manager wants to include a 12-month performance milestone tied to any signing bonus/relocation, I'm happy to include that in the offer template (helps retention).

Appreciate the quick responses — thank you both.

Summary / next steps: 
- Headcount approved: 2 (IC5 runtime, IC4/IC4+ SRE).
- Offer authority: hiring manager + Head of Platform (me) can sign up to 5% stretch and $10k signing bonus. Rishi will approve any exceptions and >$260k.
- Equity ranges: IC5 0.15%–0.3% / IC4 0.05%–0.15% (Rishi confirmed).
- Ben/Paul: prepare verbal offer for the IC5 candidate today using Offer_Template_Senior_Runtime.docx; include a 12-month retention milestone for the $10k signing bonus. If candidate pushes beyond $260k, do not verbal — escalate to Rishi.
- Dev: please confirm cost center: Platform R&D (CC: 3102).

I've attached the updated offer template and HC request with cost center and finance code. Sending to Ben to proceed with the verbal for the IC5 candidate.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference
